question: Which verified StyleKit catalog direction should govern the website redesign, given these actual media, existing logo, per-route brand/admin registers, desktop density and partial catalog-state evidence? Public pages are a B2B packaging brand/showcase website with inquiry, not checkout. Admin pages are product/back-office organised around accounts, human conversations and metrics. Preserve this per-route split while sharing one visual-token file and the existing PackJoyU wordmark. Next/React/CSS only: do not add Tailwind, UI libraries or fonts/services. The homepage has a 12.27-second real production video plus separate JPG/GIF illustration modules; product cards and 3D interaction need more visible space. Admin work surfaces must follow the saved desktop density contract, not marketing whitespace. The reference is the user-specified euproprt website; do not copy its factual company claims. All three catalog slugs were actually fetched; HTTP degraded=false but readiness.source=fallback, state coverage partial, and dark mode missing. Fill all required states explicitly; do not claim catalog verification proves rendered UI.

options.A: Use the verified catalog slug minimalist-flat for both surfaces with public brand layouts and product/back-office admin layouts. High-contrast black/white, no shadows/gradients or hover scaling, sharp borders; use the catalog-allowed accent #b45700, keep the existing own logo unchanged. Put production imagery and large 3D previews first. Override no admin spacing with marketing whitespace. Existing token consumers remain one token file.
options.B: Use the verified catalog slug scandinavian for both surfaces with the same per-route register split. Warm birch/charcoal/pine palette and natural material mood suit packaging and company media. Its large-whitespace/light-weight guidance must be scoped to public pages; admin density and readable text remain explicit project overrides in one token file.
options.C: Use the verified catalog slug korean-minimal for both surfaces with the same per-route register split. Warm white/slate/pastel colors and refined corners suit consumer packaging. Its slow motion, light typography and roomy padding must yield to direct 3D controls, reduced motion, readable text and admin density in one token file.

current: No visual direction is settled. The source app and original media are unchanged. Public pages are brand; admin is product_backoffice. No preview or human visual approval gate.
